latest_1.operation: change only the most recent non-padding source slot

C0_neutral.operation: replace each selected source slot with the neutral source ID

C1_profile_prioritized_valid.operation: replace each selected slot with an observed nonempty source ID prioritized by item-count, query-token-count, and occurrence-frequency buckets

C2_category_valid.operation: replace each selected slot through a one-to-one donor derangement that preserves source category and the three profile buckets

C3_same_user_temporal.operation: replace selected slots with an observed source from the same user's temporal source history

paired_comparison.operation: subtract the C2 dependence margin from the C0 dependence margin on identical C2-eligible rows

terminology.reader_facing_rule: Use only the canonical names above in prose, captions, legends, and paper-facing derived data.

claim_ceiling: The C2 category/profile-matched observed-support donor is not a semantic gold standard; its disagreement with the C0 neutral-mask control establishes control sensitivity, not accumulated-source use.
